name: Agronômica (Brazil)
description: Light blue field with a pale yellow triangle along the top fly and a green triangle along the bottom hoist, charged at the centre with a white disc bearing the municipal arms.
history: Agronômica is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil, founded as Pastagem by German and Italian colonists. Flags of the World records that the coat of arms is prescribed by Municipal Law No. 81 of 7 July 1971.

features.role: pale yellow triangle along the top towards the fly
green triangle along the bottom towards the hoist
municipal arms with a mural crown, a star, fruit and a landscape, reading AGRONÔMICA
